mutations.label: baseline: a session watched from late does not accuse a tree nothing changed
mutations.from: lateBaseline = appendEvent(input.cwd, session, { event: 'session.started', late: true, observation: entry.observation }) !== false
mutations.only: ^(?:a first Stop with no SessionStart does not accuse a tree nothing changed|a first mention with no SessionStart adopts the late baseline instead of accusing a pristine tree)$

mutations.label: baseline: a SessionStart in the middle of a session is not its beginning
mutations.only: ^(?:a compact SessionStart does not hand a fresh baseline to a session with outstanding work)$

mutations.label: ADR-061: a mention imports the check source before its warning reads the ledger (§269 round 4)
mutations.to: const source = name === 'publish.mentioned' ? { complete: true } : importCheckRecords(input.cwd, session)
mutations.only: ^(?:a mention reads the check that ran before it, and is logged as no publish)$
